note: Subject-topic labels, which are what the official 90-question blueprint is built from. The extractor leaves `topic`, `category` and `sign_type` null by design, and no bank carries them, so without this file no question can be placed in a quota. A label decides only WHICH QUOTA a question counts toward - it never touches the question, its options or its stated answer.
review_warning: Every entry below was assigned by Claude, not by a human, and none has been reviewed. Do not treat the quota counts as authoritative until `reviewed` is true. Set an entry's `reviewed` to true only after checking its basis, and flip the file-level flag when all entries are done.
basis_of_labels: Sign topics are taken from the `class` field of the matching entry in the manual's own sign catalogue (data/signs.json), identified by name or, for picture questions, by the stated correct answer's artwork. Non-sign topics are taken from the manual paragraph the question tests, using the chapter-2 headings in data/book.json: paragraphs 1-3 are vehicle controls, 4-26 are Rules of the Road, 27-39 are Other Matters Relating to Road Traffic Law (traffic legislation). `general_duties` marks the sub-requirement that at least 5 of the 15 Rules of the Road questions concern the general duties of a driver; it is paragraph 25, 'General duties of driver or passenger of vehicle on road'.
